name: Piggy's Harvest
tagline: Merge cute farm pigs into stronger harvesters, clear the fields and fill your piggy banks!
description: Welcome to Piggy's Harvest! Buy little pigs, then drag matching ones together to merge them into stronger pigs with bigger farm tools: knives, axes, sickles and more. Put your best pigs to work beside the plants and watch them harvest tomatoes, corn, pumpkins and other crops. Each crop pays out coins into a wooden piggy bank. Spend the coins on more pigs, keep merging and unlock new crops level after level. How far can your farm grow?
howToPlay: Mouse / Touch: drag and drop pigs to merge them and to place them next to the crops.
